decisions.reason: Active development and dedicated page indicate learning, and continued presence suggests the option value justifies a low-cost keep.
As the flagship platform and strategic focus, its option value is high and dropping is highly unlikely.
Mobile field data capture remains a relevant, low-cost option with unresolved market uncertainty, so it is kept open.
The search extension has low marginal cost, but overlapping search features make it the most uncertain option; still worth keeping open.
